content.text:
Now I have all the information needed. Let me also quickly check the `buildWidgetCss` function — specifically line 492 — to confirm the inline/block mode container has no border-radius on the container element itself (it is set to `padding:0` and `border:none` with no border-radius).

The analysis is complete. Here is the exact discrepancy:

---

## Root Cause: Hardcoded `border-radius` on the popup container — and `overflow:hidden` cutting the corners

There are **two separate problems**, one in the storefront liquid and one in the admin preview, both involving the popup modal container.

### Problem 1 — Storefront liquid: `overflow:hidden` on the modal clips the bottom corners

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`

**Line 1027–1031 — the `#WID-modal` CSS block:**
```
"#" + WID + "-modal{" +
  "background:" + cfg.backgroundColor + " !important;border-radius:16px !important;" +
  "max-width:480px !important;width:100% !important;position:relative !important;" +
  "box-shadow:0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.2) !important;animation:zcc-slide-in 0.3s ease !important" +
"}" +
```

The modal outer shell has `border-radius:16px`, which is correct. But look at the inner widget `<div>` placed inside it (line 1075):

```
'<div id="' + WID + '" data-zcc-widget="true" style="border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;max-width:none !important;padding:16px 24px 24px !important">'
```

And then look at the `buildWidgetCss` rule for `#WID` itself (line 492):

```
W + "{background:" + cfg.backgroundColor + " !important;...;padding:0 !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;max-width:480px !important;...;box-sizing:border-box !important}"
```

The inner `#WID` div gets `background: cfg.backgroundColor` applied to it by `buildWidgetCss`. This background-colored inner div fills the full width and height of the modal all the way to the edges — including the bottom corners — and because the modal does **not** have `overflow:hidden`, the inner div's rectangular corners are visible at the bottom, overriding the visual effect of `border-radius:16px` on the outer modal.

Compare this to the **floating panel** (lines 938–941), which does have `overflow:hidden`:
```
"#" + WID + "-panel{" +
  "background:" + cfg.backgroundColor + " !important;border-radius:16px !important;" +
  "box-shadow:... !important;overflow:hidden !important;" +
  ...
"}" +
```

The floating panel works correctly precisely because `overflow:hidden` is present. It clips the inner content to the rounded corners. The modal is missing `overflow:hidden`.

### Problem 2 — Admin preview: `borderRadius` value is hardcoded, does not use `cfg.borderRadius`

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`

The popup modal preview card (lines 624–634):
```tsx
<div
  style={{
    background: cfg.backgroundColor,
    borderRadius: 18,           // <-- hardcoded, ignores cfg.borderRadius
    boxShadow: "0 32px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.18), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08)",
    width: "100%",
    maxWidth: 420,
    overflow: "hidden",         // <-- overflow:hidden IS present here, so preview looks correct
    ...
  }}
>
```

The floating panel preview (lines 456–464):
```tsx
<div
  style={{
    background: cfg.backgroundColor,
    borderRadius: 14,           // <-- hardcoded, ignores cfg.borderRadius
    boxShadow: "0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.06)",
    width: "100%",
    overflow: "hidden",         // <-- present, so preview corners are clipped
    ...
  }}
>
```

The admin preview has `overflow: "hidden"` on both popup and floating containers, which is why the preview looks correct — the inner widget content is clipped to the rounded corners. But the storefront liquid is missing `overflow:hidden` on `#WID-modal`.

---

## Summary of Discrepancies

| Location | Container | `border-radius` | `overflow:hidden` | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Storefront liquid `#WID-panel` (floating) | line 939 | `16px` hardcoded | YES | Bottom corners correctly rounded |
| Storefront liquid `#WID-modal` (popup) | line 1028 | `16px` hardcoded | **MISSING** | Bottom corners clipped by inner `#WID` div background |
| Admin preview floating panel | line 459 | `14` hardcoded | YES | Looks correct |
| Admin preview popup modal | line 627 | `18` hardcoded | YES | Looks correct |

---

## The Fix

In `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`, line 1028–1030, add `overflow:hidden` to the modal CSS:

```diff
"#" + WID + "-modal{" +
-  "background:" + cfg.backgroundColor + " !important;border-radius:16px !important;" +
-  "max-width:480px !important;width:100% !important;position:relative !important;" +
-  "box-shadow:0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.2) !important;animation:zcc-slide-in 0.3s ease !important" +
+  "background:" + cfg.backgroundColor + " !important;border-radius:16px !important;overflow:hidden !important;" +
+  "max-width:480px !important;width:100% !important;position:relative !important;" +
+  "box-shadow:0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.2) !important;animation:zcc-slide-in 0.3s ease !important" +
"}" +
```

Shall I apply this fix?
